planted.description: ZSC4SAP_GS08_FM has the ADT placeholder signature ("You can use the template 'functionModuleParameter'...") and shadow locals lv_iv_carrid / lv_ev_carrname instead of IMPORTING iv_carrid / EXPORTING ev_carrname / EXCEPTIONS not_found. The FM is dead: the guard always returns, and the caller passes parameters that do not exist (runtime CALL_FUNCTION_PARM_UNKNOWN).
planted.detection_hint: GetFunctionModule(ZSC4SAP_GSFG, ZSC4SAP_GS08_FM) contains the string functionModuleParameter; FUNCTION line has no IMPORTING clause; spec/plan list 2 parameters + 1 exception.
planted.fix: FUNCTION zsc4sap_gs08_fm IMPORTING VALUE(iv_carrid) TYPE scarr-carrid EXPORTING VALUE(ev_carrname) TYPE scarr-carrname EXCEPTIONS not_found. — body selects into ev_carrname and RAISE not_found on sy-subrc <> 0.

unavoidable_secondary_findings: Unused local lv_ev_carrname, always-true IS INITIAL guard and the caller/FM parameter mismatch are facets of GS08-P1.
